title: Rabbi Elazar ben Matya

paragraphs: (A Tanna mentioned in the Mishnah.) He was one of the great students of the generation of Yavneh, as in [Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shekalim.5.1.8): in Yavneh there were four who knew seventy languages, and these are they: Ben Azzai, Ben Zoma, Ben Chakhinai and Rabbi Elazar ben Matya. In [Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 2:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Maaser_Sheni.2.4.3) they said: “Students before the sages: Chanina ben Chakhinai and Rabbi Elazar bar Matya.” But he is not counted in the list at [Sanhedrin 17b:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.4).[^2] In [Tosefta Berakhot 4](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Berakhot.4.16): an incident of four elders who were sitting in the gatehouse of Rabbi Yehoshua, and these are they: Elazar ben Matya, Chanina ben Chakhinai, Shimon ben Azzai and Shimon HaTeimani, and they were occupied with what Rabbi Akiva had taught them; and there it is implied that he also attended Rabbi Tarfon.

He is mentioned in [Mishnah Yevamot 10:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Yevamot.10.3): “This Rabbi Elazar ben Matya expounded: ‘And a woman divorced from her husband’ — and not from one who is not her husband.” In [Yevamot 94a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.94a.10), Rav said of him: “He should have expounded a pearl, and he expounded a potsherd.”

Likewise he is mentioned in a baraita in [Pesachim 79b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.79b.20), disagreeing with the sages and holding that an individual does not tip the community toward impurity; and in [Sotah 34a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.34a.8): “Rabbi Yose said: Abba Chalafta, Rabbi Elazar ben Matya and Chananyah ben Chakhinai stood on those stones that Joshua set up in the Jordan.” In Tosefta Sotah, chapter 2, Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira speaks in his name; Hyman concludes that it must be the second Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira.
What Yuchasin wishes to say, that he is the son of Matya ben Charash, Hyman rejects according to the chronology of the generations.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Sotah names Rabbi Yehudah and Rabbi Eliezer ben Matya where Hyman gives Rabbi Yose and Elazar. The Tosefta Berakhot has the elders discussing what Rabbi Tarfon taught them before Rabbi Akiva speaks. The reported Tosefta Sotah attribution is retained as cited by Hyman. In Yevamot, Rav Yehudah gives the pearl-and-potsherd line in Rav’s name. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=509&lang=en) records Yuchasin’s proposed father, which Hyman rejects on chronological grounds.

[Sanhedrin 17b:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.4) names Shimon ben Azzai, Shimon ben Zoma, Chanan the Egyptian, and Chananya ben Chakhinai. It also gives Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak’s version with a third Shimon. Neither list here names Rabbi Elazar ben Matya.
